calculation: sum_i q_i h_i D^A_ij = sum_i q_i h_i delta_ij + (1/(c+lambda)) sum_i q_i h_i L-tilde^K_ij
sum_i q_i h_i delta_ij = q_j h_j
therefore sum_i q_i h_i D^A_ij = q_j h_j
